name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.9 degrees south of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 5 visits over 67 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2026-07-02, at wavelengths from 1.29 to 4.60 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
